subject: english
options: The two forms have different tenses.
Those can point out the group, while them is an object pronoun.
Those can only follow a preposition.

optionRationales.reason: The two forms have different tenses.：它們不標示時態。
Those can point out the group, while them is an object pronoun.：指示限定與受格代名詞功能不同。
Them always means nearby students.：them 不標示近距。
Those can only follow a preposition.：those 可作主詞或限定詞。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數對象中，以群組邊界、說話者視角與近遠線索選 these 或 those，並維持複數名詞及 be 一致。」可推出 Those can point out the group, while them is an object pronoun.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Those can point out the group, while them is an object pronoun. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
